'''Hasude''' is an [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Albania|Albanian]] [[Cookbook:Dessert|dessert]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2016-05-18 |title=Hasude – cornstarch pudding |url=https://mandarina-yum.com/en/hasude-cornstarch-pudding/ |access-date=2023-04-17 |website=Mandarina |language=en-US}}</ref> 

== Ingredients ==
* 1¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (300 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Cornstarch|cornstarch]]
* 6–7 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* 1 cup (240 g) white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 2 cups (480 ml) [[Cookbook:Water|water]]

== Procedure ==
# Melt butter in [[Cookbook:Pots and Pans|pot]] over medium-high heat. Gradually mix in the cornstarch.
# Once all the cornstarch is added, cook until the mass becomes yellow. Sweeten with some sugar.
# Separately prepare a syrup using the remaining sugar and water. 
# After it is done cooking, shape the mass using a spoon or plastic shapes, and pour the syrup on top.
